questions.say: Good evening. My name is Alice, and I'm your examiner today. This is the Speaking test. In this first part, I'd like to ask you some questions about yourself. Let's talk about your home. Where do you live now?

questions.text: Which part of your home is your favourite place to relax?
questions.say: Which part of your home is your favourite place to relax?

questions.text: Have you ever lived anywhere else?
questions.say: Have you ever lived anywhere else?

questions.text: Do you write by hand much these days?
questions.say: Now let's move on to talk about handwriting. Do you write by hand much these days?

questions.text: Is your handwriting easy to read?
questions.say: Is your handwriting easy to read?

questions.text: Do you think children should still learn to write by hand?
questions.say: Do you think children should still learn to write by hand?

questions.text: Did you like science lessons at school?
questions.say: Now let's move on to talk about science. Did you like science lessons at school?

questions.text: Which science subject was your favourite?
questions.say: Which science subject was your favourite?

questions.text: Do you watch programmes about science?
questions.say: Do you watch programmes about science?

cueCard.topic: Describe a teacher who you remember well.
cueCard.explain: and explain why you remember this teacher.

questions.text: Describe a teacher who you remember well.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a teacher who you remember well. You should say: who the teacher was; what subject they taught; what they were like; and explain why you remember this teacher.

questions.text: Are you still in contact with this teacher?
questions.say: Thank you. Are you still in contact with this teacher?

questions.text: What qualities does a good teacher need?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about a teacher you remember well, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all teachers. What qualities does a good teacher need?

questions.text: Why do fewer people want to become teachers in some countries?
questions.say: Why do fewer people want to become teachers in some countries?

questions.text: Should teachers be paid more than they are now?
questions.say: Should teachers be paid more than they are now?

questions.text: Will online learning ever replace teachers in classrooms?
questions.say: Now let's talk about education in the future. Will online learning ever replace teachers in classrooms?

questions.text: What subjects do you think schools should teach in the future?
questions.say: What subjects do you think schools should teach in the future?

questions.text: Should students be allowed to choose what they study at a younger age?
questions.say: Should students be allowed to choose what they study at a younger age?
